name: run
description:
Runs `custodian run`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. A search on the line is `target` with `kind` (`reach`, `readers_of_env`, ...).

`custodian run [SPEC|ROUTE] [--kind KIND] [--job ID] [--again]`: one spec (a file, or a queued or done spec's name), a search on the line (`--kind` and a target), or every queued spec and job folder in order.

again.description: Read again even when the same spec ran over the same code. (`--again`)

job.description: The job the run is part of (the running job by default). (`--job`)

kind.description: The reading kind of a search on the line. (`--kind`)

target.description: A spec file, a queued or done spec's name, or (with `kind`) a route such as `crate:core_lib`; none runs the queue. (a word on the line)

name: list
description:
Runs `custodian list`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

`custodian list`: the inventory, rendered from the journal.

name: diff
description:
Runs `custodian diff`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

`custodian diff SPEC [--from SEQ] [--to SEQ]`: what moved between two readings of one spec (the last two by default).

spec.description: The spec's name (or its file). (a word on the line)

name: job_start
description:
Runs `custodian job start`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

`custodian job start|close|brief|import|list [NAME|ID|BUNDLE] [--kind KIND] [--target T] [--again] [--bundle]`.

intent.description: What the job is for, in the asker's words: its task history's intent record. (`--intent`)

kind.description: What the job is: a folder of specs, or one of the templates. (`--kind`)

name.description: The job's name (start), its id (close, brief; the running or last one by default), or a bundle file (import). (a word on the line)

target.description: What a template job works on (a triage's code, a route). (`--target`)

name: job_close
description:
Runs `custodian job close`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

`custodian job start|close|brief|import|list [NAME|ID|BUNDLE] [--kind KIND] [--target T] [--again] [--bundle]`.

name.description: The job's name (start), its id (close, brief; the running or last one by default), or a bundle file (import). (a word on the line)

name: job_brief
description:
Runs `custodian job brief`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. `bundle` packs the closed job as one bundle file too.

`custodian job start|close|brief|import|list [NAME|ID|BUNDLE] [--kind KIND] [--target T] [--again] [--bundle]`.

bundle.description: With brief: the closed job packed as one bundle too (its receipts, readings and the windows around its sites, secret items held redacted), as `custodian bundle <job>` makes it. (`--bundle`)

name.description: The job's name (start), its id (close, brief; the running or last one by default), or a bundle file (import). (a word on the line)

name: job_list
description:
Runs `custodian job list`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

`custodian job start|close|brief|import|list [NAME|ID|BUNDLE] [--kind KIND] [--target T] [--again] [--bundle]`.

name: test
description:
Runs `custodian test`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

`custodian test [report] [--affected | --all] [--observe failed|progress|all] [--ref REF] [--job ID]`.

action.description: `report`: the last runs' outcomes, nothing run. (a word on the line)

affected.description: Only the tests the change since `git_ref` reaches. (`--affected`)

git_ref.description: The git ref the change is measured from. (`--ref`)

job.description: The job the run is part of. (`--job`)

observe.description: What the run shows while it runs. (`--observe`)

name: check
description:
Runs `custodian check`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

`custodian check sensitivity|mechanism|boundary|supersedes|reads_env|golden|all [--job ID]`.

job.description: The job the run is part of. (`--job`)

which.description: The maintenance check to run. (a word on the line)

name: annotate
description:
Runs `custodian annotate`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. The plan only: placing it (`--apply`) is a person's.

`custodian annotate [--from CHECK_JSON] [--apply]`: the maintenance attributes the receipts call for, as a plan.

from.description: A check's JSON to plan from (the last check's by default). (`--from`)

name: features
description:
Runs `custodian features`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. The plan only: gating (`--apply`) is a person's.

`custodian features [--apply]`: code_passenger's feature-gating spec from the eligibility reading.

name: diagnostics_list
description:
Runs `custodian diagnostics list`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. `arg` is a crate, every crate by default.

`custodian diagnostics list [CRATE] | where CODE | from LOGFILE`.

arg.description: A crate (list), a diagnostic code (where), or a log file, `-` for stdin (from). (a word on the line)

name: diagnostics_where
description:
Runs `custodian diagnostics where`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. `arg` is the diagnostic code.

`custodian diagnostics list [CRATE] | where CODE | from LOGFILE`.

arg.description: A crate (list), a diagnostic code (where), or a log file, `-` for stdin (from). (a word on the line)

name: diagnostics_from
description:
Runs `custodian diagnostics from`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. `arg` is the log file.

`custodian diagnostics list [CRATE] | where CODE | from LOGFILE`.

arg.description: A crate (list), a diagnostic code (where), or a log file, `-` for stdin (from). (a word on the line)

name: triage
description:
Runs `custodian triage`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

`custodian triage CODE|@LOGFILE`: the built-in triage job, started and closed.

target.description: A diagnostic code, or `@` and a log file. (a word on the line)

name: bundle
description:
Runs `custodian bundle`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

`custodian bundle ROUTE|JOB [--no-tests] [--no-benches] [--no-examples] [--no-feature F] [--only src] [--redact-level secret] [--reveal]`.

again.description: Bundle again even when the same bundle exists over the same code. (`--again`)

no_feature.description: Leave out the code behind this feature. (`--no-feature`)

redact_level.description: Redact items at this sensitivity level. (`--redact-level`)

target.description: A route, or a job's id. (a word on the line)

name: count
description:
Runs `custodian count`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. `args` is the one route, the workspace by default.

`custodian count [ROUTE] [--by crate|language] [--tests] [--again]`, `count report A B`, `count history [ROUTE]`: files, lines, code, comments and blanks (custodian_kit's `count` reading kind, on tokei), per crate or language, the tests' share; two counts compared; every count of a route.

again.description: Count again even when the code has not moved. (`--again`)

args.description: A route; or `report A B`; or `history [ROUTE]`. (a word on the line)

job.description: The job the count is part of (a job's own counts at open and close). (`--job`)

name: count_report
description:
Runs `custodian count report`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. `args` names the two counts, A then B: a receipt number, a job id, a commit or a date.

`custodian count [ROUTE] [--by crate|language] [--tests] [--again]`, `count report A B`, `count history [ROUTE]`: files, lines, code, comments and blanks (custodian_kit's `count` reading kind, on tokei), per crate or language, the tests' share; two counts compared; every count of a route.

args.description: A route; or `report A B`; or `history [ROUTE]`. (a word on the line)

name: count_history
description:
Runs `custodian count history`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. `args` is the route, every route by default.

`custodian count [ROUTE] [--by crate|language] [--tests] [--again]`, `count report A B`, `count history [ROUTE]`: files, lines, code, comments and blanks (custodian_kit's `count` reading kind, on tokei), per crate or language, the tests' share; two counts compared; every count of a route.

args.description: A route; or `report A B`; or `history [ROUTE]`. (a word on the line)
